integrity: The density proof is obtained by starting the source's positive-measure closed-condition forcing construction inside an arbitrary basic cylinder. The exact covering number then follows from the dyadic cylinder partition and the ultrametric separation of distinct cylinders. The Hausdorff-dimension-zero side is the source's Corollary 3.24, with the generic class handled by inclusion in the weakly generic class.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns classical box-counting dimension of the full genericity classes in Cantor space with the standard ultrametric. It does not assert any individual effective-dimension property, and it does not claim analogous full box dimension on arbitrary computable probability spaces without additional geometric hypotheses.
title: Full box dimension for higher effective genericity despite zero Hausdorff dimension
